purpose_text.para: When high exception vectors are not selected, holds the vector base address for exceptions that are not taken to Monitor mode or to Hyp mode.
Software must program VBAR(NS) with the required initial value as part of the PE boot sequence.

reg_bank.bank_text: This register is banked between VBAR and VBAR_S and VBAR_NS.

attributes_text.para: This register has the following instances:

listitem.content: VBAR, when EL3 is not implemented or FEAT_AA64 is implemented.

field_description.para: Vector Base Address. Bits[31:5] of the base address of the exception vectors for exceptions taken to this Exception level. Bits[4:0] of an exception vector are the exception offset.
